2 duel tournaments, '''Monday 26th July - Tuesday 27nd July''', with one tournament per day. 
One-night tournaments in best of 3 format, with fraglimit.

== Format ==
* Single-Elimination, Fraglimit
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} 

* '''MONDAY 26/7''' : DM2 - 10 FRAGS, DM4 - 40 FRAGS, DM6 - 30 FRAGS (timelimit 30 min per map)
* '''TUESDAY 27/7''' : BRAVADO, SHIFTER, SKULL - 60 FRAGS PER MAP (timelimit 20 min per map)
